content_sections.heading: CERC Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 56 years for all posts. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CERC Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://cercind.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 08-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CERC recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the CERC recruitment is 08 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by CERC?
faq.answer: Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC) has released a total of 8 vacancies for various posts, including Joint Chief (Legal), Deputy Chief (Legal), Assistant Chief (Legal), and Bench Officer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Joint Chief (Legal) post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Joint Chief (Legal) post is a Degree in Law, preferably with specialization in regulation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CERC recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts released by CERC is 56 years. No specific minimum age limit is mentioned.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for CERC recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the CERC recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can candidates apply for the CERC recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply offline by downloading the application form from the official website, filling it correctly, attaching necessary documents, and sending it to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the Joint Chief (Legal) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Joint Chief (Legal) post falls under Level-13, ranging from Rs. 1,23,100 to Rs. 2,15,900/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for CERC recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the CERC recruitment involves an Interaction with the candidates. Further details will be provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for CERC recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for CERC recruitment can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this CERC recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Deputation. Candidates will be selected on a deputation basis for the announced posts.
